visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man's face superimposed onto a high-fidelity astronaut suit. He stands on a simulated lunar surface with craters and gray dust. In the background, a dark rover with bright blue wheels is visible against a black star-filled sky. (2) Close-up shots of microscopic moon dust particles are shown, appearing jagged and translucent. (3) Historical-style footage of an original Apollo astronaut walking on the moon is intercut, showing the gray dust clinging to the white suit fabric. (4) A glass kettle filled with rapidly boiling water is shown, emphasizing extreme heat. (5) A digital screen with a spiderweb of cracks appears, symbolizing material failure under cold. (6) A high-angle shot reveals a blue non-pneumatic tire with a complex honeycomb structure rolling through simulated lunar regolith. (7) A close-up shows the Michelin logo and CNES branding on the side of a mechanical rover. (8) Detailed CGI animation of the tire's internal blue flexible vanes flexing as they roll over obstacles. (9) Historical black and white footage from 1946 shows a radial tire being tested on a machine. (10) The man in the astronaut suit reappears, gesturing with gloved hands as he speaks directly to the camera.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main creator whose face is superimposed on an astronaut body.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged man with glasses, wearing an Apollo-style white astronaut suit with mission patches.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A CGI reconstruction of the lunar surface with craters, an Earth-rise in the distance, and studio-lit close-ups of mechanical parts and boiling water.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy electronic synthesizer bed starts immediately. A male voice begins speaking with high clarity and a rapid, authoritative pace. (2) A sharp 'Whoosh' sound effect accompanies the first visual transition. (3) The vocal intensity increases as he describes the dangers of moon dust. (4) A bubbly, fizzing sound effect of boiling water is layered over the music. (5) A sharp 'Crack' SFX coincides with the visual of the broken screen. (6) A rhythmic digital 'ding' sounds as checkboxes appear on screen. (7) The BGM swells with a cinematic build-up as the tire technology is revealed. (8) Low-frequency percussive hits punctuate the mention of historical dates. (9) The narrator's voice maintains a consistent, professional projection until the final sign-off, accompanied by a bright digital chime SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem -> Engineering Challenge -> Solution -> Brand Heritage -> Future Vision
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Michelin's technical innovation and engineering prowess by showcasing their advanced non-pneumatic tire developed for lunar exploration missions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of the Michelin logo, detailed explanation of their specific proprietary materials (PEEK), and direct verbal mention of Michelin's history.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced commercial-educational hybrid using green-screen technology and high-quality CGI to explain complex materials science.
